newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat ends mixed in subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat ends mixed in subdued trade.

text.p: LIFFE wheat last traded tightly mixed after a subdued day's business.
An easier sterling pushed prices up early, but the gains were cut by shipper selling, one trader said.
Later in the day the market fell into a torpor, with little movement.
"Roll on harvest," he said. More and definite information about what the wheat crop looks like would give market players something to trade on.
May 1998 was most active, with 59 lots, of a total 225. It last changed hands unchanged at 88.00 stg.
March was most active on barley, with 20 of the total 38 lots. It last traded unchanged at 81.00 stg.
